hero.title: 3-Gas Floor Control Panel
hero.description: Safe, intelligent and uninterrupted control for your medical gas systems. Central management of 3 different medical gases on a single panel.

heroFeatures.title: High Safety
heroFeatures.text: Maximum safety with alarm and automatic shut-off system.

heroFeatures.title: Intelligent Control
heroFeatures.text: Continuous monitoring with a microprocessor-based control unit.

heroFeatures.title: Alarm System
heroFeatures.text: Instant notification through visual and audible alerts.

heroFeatures.title: Easy Installation
heroFeatures.text: Fast and easy installation with a practical connection design.

detailCards.title: Gas Connection Unit
detailCards.text: High-quality valve system for oxygen, vacuum and air gas inlets.

detailCards.title: Intelligent Control Panel
detailCards.text: Gas pressures are monitored and managed in real time with the microprocessor-controlled system.

detailCards.title: Durable Construction
detailCards.text: Its electrostatically painted metal enclosure ensures long service life and impact resistance.

advantages.title: Advantages
items: Central control of three different gases on a single panel
Easy monitoring through a user-friendly interface

items.title: Central Control
items.text: Management of 3 gases from a single point

items.title: Real-Time Monitoring
items.text: Pressure values are continuously monitored and recorded

items.title: Reliable Alarm
items.text: Instant alerts through visual and audible alarms

items.a: The 3-Gas Floor Control Panel supports Oxygen (O2), Vacuum (VAC) and Medical Air (AIR) gases.
It is used in hospitals, intensive care units, operating rooms and clinical areas.
It can be installed with surface-mounted or flush-mounted options.

items.q: How are maintenance and service requirements handled?
items.a: Safe operation is maintained through periodic maintenance and technical service support.

items.q: How does the alarm system work?
items.a: It provides audible and visual alarms when pressure values exceed the specified limits.

items.q: Does the system operate during a power outage?
items.a: Backup power and alarm scenarios can be implemented according to project requirements.
